amendment: Repair historical episode eligibility before a new untouched final opening. No model, candidate choice, calibration, threshold, estimand, effect gate or bootstrap setting changes.
failure_boundary: The v1 attempt generated the OS new-catalog arrays in memory, then stopped on duplicate historical step identifiers before saving catalogs or running any final model prediction. The failed attempt remains ineligible and is not reused.
historical_exclusion: Before computing eligibility or model predictions, exclude every historical episode containing duplicate step identifiers. Record exact excluded episode IDs and counts. Apply this rule equally to every comparator; do not collapse duplicates or invent an order. Retain the prior requirement for five contiguous eligible transitions.
portable_digest_rule: Model, NPZ catalog and PDF identities are byte-exact. UTF-8 JSON metadata may use LF or CRLF line endings; verify against explicit equivalent encodings without accepting any other content change. Source-code bindings already normalize CRLF to LF.
scientific_policy: V1 remains a failed attempt. V2 is a new prospectively registered opening with unchanged selected models and thresholds, not a rerun or recovery of v1 final evidence.
